AuthorDBBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the embedded FastAPI Authorship DB app, as seen by the browser. Use a same-origin reverse-proxy path (e.g. /authordb) for the smoothest iframe + cookie behaviour.

AuthorDBSecret.description: Shared HMAC secret used to sign the SSO handoff token. MUST be identical to the app's AUTHOR_DB_SECRET environment variable. Leave empty to disable SSO (read-only embed only).

AuthorDBSsoTtl.description: Lifetime in seconds of a minted SSO handoff token. Keep this short (the token is consumed immediately when the iframe loads).

AuthorDBFrameHeight.description: Fallback min-height in pixels of the embedded iframe, used only when JavaScript is disabled. With JS enabled the ext.authorDB.frame module auto-sizes the frame to its content.

AuthorDBInternalUrl.description: Server-side base URL the wiki uses to fetch fragments from the app (the <authordb-list/> parser tag). Unlike AuthorDBBaseUrl this is resolved from PHP on the wiki server, so it can point straight at uvicorn — but it must still include the app's ROOT_PATH prefix.

AuthorDBListCacheTtl.description: Parser cache TTL in seconds for pages containing <authordb-list/> — how stale the embedded author list may get before the page re-fetches it from the app.
